messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 — embeddings-service 5xx spike detected (us-west). Error rate 5% over baseline, latency tail up 200ms. PagerDuty: #INC-4821.
Maya Li: I’m primary today but my flight got delayed, ETA to handoff is 2.5h later. I can still do remote triage for a bit but need to swap primary asap. :airplane:
Akshay Patel: I can take primary if needed. I’m in the call channel and can be on pager. confirm me and I’ll update rotation.
Sam O'Neill: I can shadow for the next 30m then take over until Akshay is settled.
Priya Rao: Quick ask — what’s the customer impact? Are any external SLAs at risk? Also drop the runbook link pls.
Maya Li: Impact: search and recommendations experiencing degraded embeddings scoring. Approximately 7% of queries hitting the degraded path. No large customer-visible outage yet but spike in errors hitting a subset of shards in us-west. A few internal dashboards show increased 504/502 from the embeddings API.
Maya Li: A snippet from logs: 
```
2026-03-15T02:12:43Z embeddings-0 pod/embeddings-0 container runtime error: grpc: code = Unknown desc = model allocator OOM
2026-03-15T02:12:45Z embeddings-2 pod/embeddings-2 container fetch failed: kv-cache miss + retry
```
Maya Li: Runbook: https://console.internal/runbooks/embeddings-high-5xx (follow section "hotfix-scale-rollback") — TL;DR: 1) scale replicas for canaries, 2) enable soft-eviction, 3) temporarily route critical traffic to fallback model variant.
Jordan Kim: I’ll prepare the scale command. Proposing +2 replicas to embeddings-workers in us-west and patch autoscaler to ignore burst limits for 20m.
Jordan Kim: Run: ```kubectl -n prod scale deployment embeddings-workers --replicas=8 --kubeconfig=/secrets/prod``` then ```kubectl -n prod patch hpa embeddings-workers -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleUp":{"policies":[{"type":"Percent","value":200,"periodSeconds":60}]}}}}'```
Akshay Patel: Ok I’m switching to primary now. oncall-scheduler-bot: set primary "Akshay Patel" for eng-oncall (effective now)
oncall-scheduler-bot: acknowledged — primary updated to Akshay Patel. :white_check_mark:
Akshay Patel: Taking lead. My immediate plan: 1) apply Jordan’s scale, 2) enable soft-eviction (config flag), 3) monitor error-rate and tail latency. If no improvement in 10m, route critical customers to fallback-quantized model.
Sam O'Neill: Copy — I’ll own communications and keep a rolling note for the post-incident ticket. Adding a note to #incidents channel after initial stabilization.
Priya Rao: Can someone paste the exact command to enable soft-eviction? I don’t want to guess flags.
Maya Li: ```http PATCH https://config-api.internal/services/embeddings -d '{"softEvictionEnabled":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'``` Also you can flip via ksvc config: ```kubectl -n prod set env deployment/embeddings-workers SOFT_EVICTION=true```
Akshay Patel: Scale applied. HPA patch applied. Enabling soft-eviction now. Monitoring Prometheus and traces (link: https://telemetry.internal/embeddings?range=15m).
incident-bot: Update — error rate reduced to 2.1% after scale, p50 latency unchanged, p95 down 120ms. Keep watch for 15m window.
Sam O'Neill: :eyes: Looks promising. Akshay — please add yourself to the rotation handoff note and confirm when you want Maya to fully sign off.
Akshay Patel: Will hold primary for 3h then coordinate handback to Maya if she’s available. Marking this thread as the live-watch handoff. I opened INC-4821-TO-OPS with mitigation notes.
Maya Li: Thank you team — I’m going to try to reschedule my connection to join the postmortem. If anything spikes again ping me. Good handoff. :heart:
Sam O'Neill: Adding runbook snippet to the ticket and linking dashboards. Will follow up with retrospective doc.
oncall-scheduler-bot: rotation note: Akshay Patel -> primary (2026-03-15T02:20Z), Sam O'Neill -> secondary-shadow until 02:55Z.
Akshay Patel: Confirmed. I’ll also create a temporary canary route if we see a second spike.
Priya Rao: Great — thanks everyone. I’ll monitor customer comms and coordinate any external notifications if SLA risk increases.
Sam O'Neill: Closing the immediate swap conversation — we’ll keep this thread as the incident watch log. Feel free to ping here for quick updates. :thumbsup:
